precise_claim.interval: I=[-1/2,1/2], Lebesgue dx, equivalence modulo a.e.
precise_claim.density_space: D={u in real L1(I):u>=0 a.e., integral_I u dx=1}; relative L1 metric
precise_claim.parameter_quantifiers: For each fixed 0<A<=2/5 and 6<B<=16, set G(m)=A tanh(Bm/A); no A=0, B=6, or arbitrary feedback extension.
precise_claim.maps: For |r|<=2/5, f_r(x)=((r+4)x+r+1)/(2rx+2); T_r=f_r for x<-r/4 and f_r-1 for x>-r/4; cut value irrelevant modulo absolutely continuous laws. P_r is pushforward density transfer, F(u)=P_{G(phi(u))}u.
precise_claim.basins: W={u:F^n u ->1 in L1}; B_pm={u:F^n u->u_pm in L1}.
precise_claim.new_intermediate: For each fixed u in W, there exist densities v_n, for every n>=1, with F^n(v_n)=1 and ||v_n-u||_1->0. No attraction rate assumption.
precise_claim.regularity: All probability densities, including unbounded densities and densities vanishing on sets of positive Lebesgue measure; no BV, L2(dx), positive lower bound, or L1 differentiable stable manifold assumed.
precise_claim.auxiliary_probability_space: (I,u dx), every random variable X_j bounded in I even if u is not in L2(dx); inverse V defined for all J=[-1/2,3/2]-valued bounded random variables on any real probability-space L2.
precise_claim.inverse_iteration: r=G(E b_r(Z)), V(Z)=b_r(Z), b_r(z)=(2z-r-1)/(r+4-2rz), contraction21/25 in probability L2. Fix n, terminal H_n(y)=-1/2+integral_-1/2^y F^n(u)(t)dt; preserve original branch labels and lift backwards with self-consistent feedback.
precise_claim.key_limit_order: epsilon_n=||F^n u-1||_1->0; first fix continuous g approximating fixed u and let n->infinity, then let ||u-g||_1->0. No interchange/uniform convergence over all u claimed.
precise_claim.topology_boundary_cases: D relative boundary, full TV convention equals L1 for densities; flat cumulative maps allowed, branch zero fibers handled, endpoints/cuts are null for densities.
